title: 経営情報専門実験・演習A
subtitle: Management Systems Major Lab/Exercises A
keywords: Marketing 2.Management Plan 3.Financial management and Sales management 4.Regional Revitalization 5.Co-creation with Society
educationalGoal: This course is aimed at improving "Practical skills in business application"such as 1) Marketing 2) Deepen understanding of knowledge and skills in finance through experiments and exercises. Specially, 1) knowledge necessary for marketing promotion through experimental of a pseudo-business and 2) knowledge and skills necessary to create a business plan centering on financial plans. Learn practically through co-creation with society using CDIO concept.
advice: 1) "Management plan" preparation exercise Exercises on "short-term business plan" creation of start-up business. Exercises depend on secondary data for required data, and active learning that effectively utilizes knowledge and skills. 2) Marketing exercise A marketing strategy that uses the Needs-STP-4P framework in accordance with the methods of modern marketing that have been trained in specialized courses. The purpose of this is to learn as a practical science by planning and experimenting in the real market. It is necessary to review the theory of training sufficiently and to conduct an exercise after observing and considering the real world product and service markets.
requiredKnowledge: In management analysis exercises, basic knowledge and skills to collect and analyze secondary data from the Internet, newspapers, publications, etc., and basic knowledge and skills to create a financial plan are required. In marketing exercises, it is necessary to observe and consider the real-world product and service markets recently.

activityGoals.body: Collect and analyze the secondary data required to create the "management plan"
"Management plans" can be compiled into documents and announced to third parties with details.
Develop strategies using marketing knowledge and frameworks.
Apply marketing strategies designed in real-world marketsa and analyze their effects and problems.
Organize the activities that you have undertaken to achieve your goals and explain logically.
